Figure 3:Overview of Event-STVG benchmark construction and composition. We construct Event-STVG through carefully designed human annotation with automated tracking assistance and multi-stage quality control. The resulting benchmark exhibits substantial diversity in event types and semantic roles, covering major soccer events and seven additional domains.
